newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle market thinly tested-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle market thinly tested-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle sold Monday at $64.00 per cwt, although trade was too light for an adequate market test, feedlot sources said.
About 500 heifers likely to grade select and choice sold at $64.00 in Kansas near midday. There were no reported sales in the Texas Panhandle and western Oklahoma area.
Other bids were light at $64.00 and passed by owners asking $65.00 to $68.00, with most at $66.00, they said.
Last sales were active Friday at $65.00, down $1.00 from light trade the previous Tuesday.
